avoid_supplements.name: High-dose vitamin C (>2000mg daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Increases uric acid excretion and may reduce febuxostat efficacy; can precipitate uric acid crystals in renal tubules
avoid_supplements.action: Limit vitamin C to <1000mg daily; counsel on adequate hydration

avoid_supplements.name: Niacin supplements (>1500mg daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Niacin competes with uric acid for renal excretion and reduces febuxostat effectiveness
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose niacin; consult prescriber if supplementation needed

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle (Silybum marianum)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP2C8/2C9 inhibition may increase febuxostat levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects; consider alternative hepatoprotective if needed

caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP1A2 and CYP2C9 induction may reduce febuxostat exposure
caution_supplements.action: Monitor serum uric acid levels; may require febuxostat dose adjustment

avoid_foods.name: High-purine foods (organ meats, anchovies, sardines, mussels)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Excessive purine intake increases uric acid production, counteracting febuxostat's therapeutic effect
avoid_foods.action: Counsel on low-purine diet; recommend lean proteins and plant-based alternatives

avoid_foods.name: High-fructose foods (sugar-sweetened beverages, honey, agave)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Fructose metabolism increases uric acid synthesis and impairs renal excretion
avoid_foods.action: Limit added sugars and high-fructose corn syrup; emphasize water and unsweetened beverages

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (especially beer)
caution_foods.mechanism: Alcohol increases uric acid production and inhibits renal excretion; beer contains purines
caution_foods.action: Limit to ≤1-2 drinks daily; counsel on gout attack risk with excessive consumption

caution_foods.name: Red meat and processed meats
caution_foods.mechanism: Moderate purine content may incrementally increase uric acid levels
caution_foods.action: Moderate intake; encourage fish and plant proteins; monitor serum uric acid response

monitoring_notes: Monitor serum uric acid levels 2-4 weeks after initiation to assess efficacy; educate patients on gout attack risk during initial febuxostat therapy and ensure adequate hydration (2-3L water daily). Reassess at 2-5 weeks if target uric acid not achieved (<6 mg/dL for most patients).
